# GitHub Configuration

## Purpose
The `.github` folder contains repository collaboration files for the AI Engineer Pack, including issue templates, pull request guidance, workflow definitions, and community health support.

## Contents
- [ISSUE_TEMPLATE](ISSUE_TEMPLATE): issue forms for bugs, feature requests, documentation improvements, and skill requests.
- [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md): review checklist for proposed changes.
- `workflows/`: repository automation for documentation quality checks.

## Usage
Use these files to standardize how contributors report problems, request improvements, propose new skills, and prepare pull requests. Keep templates specific to the AI Engineer Pack and aligned with [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
